description:
Validate a site's /llms.txt against the llms.txt format (plain text, H1 title, summary, link sections with descriptions, links that resolve); each finding by line and severity.

Billing: free.

When to call: the user asks about llms.txt, or a crawl or audit flags it. On WordPress the free AuditAE plugin serves and maintains it automatically.

Returns { url, status, missing, verdict: pass|warn|fail, generator?, counts, findings: [{ line, severity, code, message }], links_checked, links_not_checked, links_note?, cached_at, since_last_check?, suggested_next?, next_step }. missing: no usable file (error status or fetch error). Up to 25 same-site links are opened. generator: the SEO plugin that wrote it (Rank Math, Yoast…); next_step says what its settings can and can't change. Errors or warnings: next_step is the free fix and there's no suggested_next; otherwise suggested_next is one priced step (on a paired WordPress site with no usable file, the plugin's llms.txt reset).

domain.description: Hostname or URL of the site, e.g. "acme.com".

name: check_llms_txt
title: Validate a site's llms.txt
